COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

2. Which statement about Intercultural competence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Intercultural competence never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Intercultural competence.
   C. Treat Intercultural competence as rumours only.
   D. Explain Intercultural competence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

4. Which statement about Leadership Development is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Leadership Development never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Leadership Development with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Leadership Development as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Leadership Development.

5. Which statement about Concept of Community Service Learning is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Concept of Community Service Learning with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Concept of Community Service Learning.
   C. Treat Concept of Community Service Learning as rumours only.
   D. Say Concept of Community Service Learning never happens in Kenya.

6. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

7. Which statement about Responsible Decision Making is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Responsible Decision Making as rumours only.
   B. Explain Responsible Decision Making with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Responsible Decision Making.
   D. Say Responsible Decision Making never happens in Kenya.

8. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nakuru
   D. Nairobi

9. Which statement about Intercultural Competence 2.0 Life Skills in Education 2.1 Self-Awareness in the  is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Intercultural Competence 2.0 Life Skills in Education 2.1 Self-Awareness in the  as rumours only.
   B. Explain Intercultural Competence 2.0 Life Skills in Education 2.1 Self-Awareness in the  with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Intercultural Competence 2.0 Life Skills in Education 2.1 Self-Awareness in the  never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Intercultural Competence 2.0 Life Skills in Education 2.1 Self-Awareness in the .

10. Which statement about Conflict Resolution is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Conflict Resolution.
   B. Say Conflict Resolution never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Conflict Resolution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Conflict Resolution as rumours only.

11. Which statement about Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp.
   C. Explain Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp as rumours only.

12. Which statement about Self- Awareness in the Community is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Self- Awareness in the Community as rumours only.
   B. Say Self- Awareness in the Community never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Awareness in the Community.
   D. Explain Self- Awareness in the Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Responsible Decision Making and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Action Research and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Implementing an Intervention 4.0 Social and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

1. D — Explain symbols used on a map

2. D — Explain Intercultural competence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. D — Obeying laws and caring for public property

4. B — Explain Leadership Development with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. A — Explain Concept of Community Service Learning with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. D — Plan income and spending wisely

7. B — Explain Responsible Decision Making with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. D — Nairobi

9. B — Explain Intercultural Competence 2.0 Life Skills in Education 2.1 Self-Awareness in the  with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. C — Explain Conflict Resolution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. C — Explain Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. D — Explain Self- Awareness in the Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Responsible Decision Making; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Introduction to Action Research; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Implementing an Intervention 4.0 Social; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
